title: EventBus multiple callback exceptions delivery isolation contract

contract.multiple_exception_isolation: Multiple callback exceptions during one event delivery do not abort EventBus delivery
contract.exception_containment: Each callback exception is contained independently by EventBus.emit()
contract.delivery_continuity: Callbacks after one or more failing callbacks continue receiving the active event
contract.delivery_order: All listeners continue receiving the event in registration order
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() returns true after multiple callback exceptions are contained
contract.registry_preservation: Multiple callback failures do not modify the listener registry
contract.listener_preservation: Failing callbacks remain registered after their exceptions
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus.emit() requires the events permission before delivery
